text:
leah: Quick pulse — Greyline on‑prem cutover scheduled TOMORROW 10:00 PDT. Need final owners for two last-mile items: edge-router TLS cert rotation (airgapped registry) and egress/NAT fallback plan. Who can own and confirm by 08:00? cc @net-eng @ops

samir: I can take cert rotation. Will push rotated cert bundle to the offline registry and kick the edge update. Targeting 07:30 so we have a buffer. :thumbsup:

leah: awesome, thanks. Samir please add the registry digest in the rollout doc when done.

michael_neteng: I'll own the egress fallback design + BGP sanity. Plan is to configure the secondary egress via the colo NAT appliance and keep the primary to our transit. I'll test connectivity by 08:45.

tanya_ops: I'll run the smoke prober after Samir's cert update and Michael's route flip. Quick script I use locally:
```
# run from jumpbox inside tenant net
curl -v "http://10.0.5.13/egress-check?probe=greyline" -H "Host: egress-prober.internal" --max-time 10
```
If that returns 200+json with ttl checks we're good. I'll post results.

ira_security: reminder — make sure cert rotation uses the limited-scope leaf key in HSM and we log the key-use event to audit. Samir, can you confirm HSM signing step included?

samir: yes — HSM signing step included. I'll attach the audit id in the rollout doc.

michael_neteng: small dependency: colo team requires ASN pinning before we flip secondary egress. I've opened ticket COLO-291. Need an ack from colo by 06:45 or we delay flip plan.

leah: thanks — can colo-team rep reply in this thread? If they can't make 06:45, alternate is to pre-seed routes but hold withdraw until manual go.

ops-bot: scheduled: greyline-smoke at 2026-03-18T09:15:00Z (will run after cert rotation). Noted owners: cert=samir, egress=michael_neteng, smoke=tanya_ops.

tanya_ops: posting quick checklist I'll run after cert push:
- verify cert digest on node
- restart edge-router service (graceful)
- run prober (curl above)
- validate logs for 2xx and origin IP
I'll paste results here.

michael_neteng: if colo ack is missing by 06:45 I suggest we hold the BGP withdraw and instead enable NAT fallback with these commands (short):
```
# enable fallback route map
set ip route 0.0.0.0/0 next-hop 198.51.100.1 track 109
# set mrt metric lower for primary, higher for fallback
```
This lets us keep primary; fallback only used on failure.

leah: decision flow noted. Owners: Samir (cert), Michael (egress config), Tanya (smoke), Ira (security/audit). Deadline to confirm = 08:00 PDT. If any blocker post here ASAP. :eyes:

samir: pushed certs to offline registry and added digest: sha256:bb3f... in rollout doc. HSM audit id: HSM-4821.

ops-bot: smoke scheduled trigger queued for 2026-03-18T09:15:00Z.

tanya_ops: smoke run at 09:17: PASS — prober response 200, ttl checks OK, origin-ip matches expected. Logs attached in ops-runbook (link). :white_check_mark:

michael_neteng: colo ack came in at 06:30 (COLO-291 resolved). Did a dry-run BGP withdraw at 08:50 with no traffic loss. Ready for cutover.

ira_security: audit log shows HSM signing event and cert push. No anomalies.

leah: incredible — thank you all. Will proceed with 10:00 cutover. Post any post-cutover anomalies here and we'll triage. :rocket:
